target.statement: MEOW achieves forget quality (F.Q.) of 0.99 on ToFU-1% with Llama2-7B-Chat, compared to 0.00 for the origin model and 1.00 for the retain model.

compute.basis: Fine-tuning Llama2-7B-Chat on ToFU-1% requires a GPU with sufficient VRAM (e.g., A100 80GB as used in the paper); on a CPU-only laptop, training would be impractically slow or impossible.

blockers: Requires fine-tuning a 7B parameter model, which is not feasible on a CPU-only laptop within a few hours.
The paper uses 2 NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB GPUs for training, indicating high VRAM requirements.
Generating inverted facts requires an offline LLM (e.g., GPT-4), which may involve API costs or access restrictions.
title: MEOW: MEMOry Supervised LLM Unlearning Via Inverted Facts
